text: Check the weather – no rain forecast for 24 hours.
Record batch numbers and keep photos of each stage.
Detail corners and outlets before the main coats.
Don't apply over standing water or on a dusty surface.
Don't skip the ponding / flood test.
Apply coats crosswise for uniform thickness.
Don't apply below 10°C or above 40°C surface temperature.
Use the full A + B kit – never split packs by eye.
Don't add extra water to make it flow.
Roll every lap firmly with a pressure roller.
Don't leave the membrane exposed to sun for weeks.
Keep the membrane face clean before the concrete pour.
Don't puncture with rebar chairs – use protection pads.
Check wet-film thickness with a gauge.
Don't apply on a damp substrate.
